newsitem.title: FRANCE: BASKETBALL-PAU-ORTHEZ SIGN REPLACEMENT FOR BLAIR. [CORRECTED 19:00 GMT]
newsitem.headline: BASKETBALL-PAU-ORTHEZ SIGN REPLACEMENT FOR BLAIR. [CORRECTED 19:00 GMT]

text.p: Former Sacramento Kings player (corrects from "defence") Lawrence Thunderburke joined Pau-Orthez of France for six weeks on Thursday as stand-in for injured fellow American Joseph Blair.

The 2.5-metre 25-year-old, who was drafted by the Kings two years ago and played in Israel and for Greek team PAOK Salonika with an average eight rebounds per match last season, makes his debut against Limoges on Sunday.
Pau-Orthez were having to play without Blair, who has a thigh injury, in their EuroLeague third round group D match away to Partizan Belgrade of Yugoslavia on Thursday night.
